firm_data.firm_name: Rottenstreich Farley Bronstein Fisher Potter Hodas LLP
firm_data.firm_description: Rottenstreich Farley Bronstein Fisher Potter Hodas is a law firm specializing in high-net-worth divorce and family law cases, often involving white-collar litigation. It was founded in 2023 from the merger of two matrimonial law firms, one in New York and one in Palm Beach, Florida.
notable_facts: The firm has been recognized as a top firm nationally in divorces where "big money" is in play.
The firm's team includes former government prosecutors, trial lawyers, commercial litigators, and trust and estate experts.
The firm handles complex financial holdings, including foreign and domestic trusts and offshore assets.
